# Safwan Digital — Mohammed Safwan

> Mohammed Safwan is a digital marketer from Palakkad, Kerala, India, working in digital marketing since 2021. He is a digital marketing generalist working across Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, AEO and GEO (AI search optimisation), mostly with B2B and healthcare brands. He works full-time with a digital marketing agency in Bangalore (remotely) and takes freelance consultations on the side. He serves businesses across Kerala and India, and brands in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and other GCC countries. He speaks English and Malayalam. YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@safwan.99

- [About](https://safwandigital.com/about/): background (BA English, digital marketing since 2021, agency, in-house and freelance experience)
- [Blog](https://safwandigital.com/blog/): lessons from real campaigns
